selectedA2Kernel.rationale: High-information structure with strong colour participation; reconstructable without specialist media.
Proves asymmetric Porcelain/Persian chapter composition and verified-content slots.
Small but distinctive full-width brand-energy bridge.
Proves layered wave descent, navigation density and mobile regrouping.
Chosen deliberately from the weak CTA cluster to test whether the frame grammar can be retained without architecture dominating.
Reusable proof structure with real portrait/content slots.
Founder-approved Porcelain grammar with dots, gold current and trust rail.
Compact, insertion-ready decision support that broadens semantic coverage.

strongReferencesNotForced.reason: Founder favourite depends on realistic clinical 3D/CBCT media and planning controls. The surrounding grammar is reusable, but truthful media requires a separately authorised media/3D tranche.
Exploded implant anatomy is specialist clinical media; a CSS or generic SVG substitute would be a false success.
Contains Sacred Hero V2 lineage. A2 may learn from the post-Hero transition but must not reconstruct or mutate the Hero.
